name: speech
description: Text-to-speech narration. The narrate skill turns a script into narration.wav plus words.json, a start and end time for every word. The default kokoro backend runs Kokoro-82M locally with onnxruntime. The optional elevenlabs backend sends the text to the third-party ElevenLabs API (ELEVENLABS_API_KEY) after showing a cost estimate; an organization can forbid it. You install espeak-ng (GPL-3.0). A hook installs the Python packages; setup downloads the models; check reports missing prerequisites.
